A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Llamdex research paper, including complete Appendices A–G. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v4 reports original accuracy, efficiency, privacy-attack, and ablation experiments in Section 6, with further empirical results in Appendices B–D.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experiments and appendix results, including additional dataset evaluations and component ablations.

M1.justification: The expert-model integration, encoder and decoder architecture, training objectives, inference procedure, and iterative reasoning mechanism in Section 5 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Titanic, wine, bank, nursery, and adult datasets. The question-answering tasks, privacy evaluations, and incomplete-schema scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within corresponding main-text and appendix experiments. Original LLM, Real Data LoRA, Expert API, PATE-GAN, SeqPATE, PromptPATE, Table Diffusion, and DP-OPT retain their respective comparisons.

E3.justification: The 80/20 data splits, 10% feature masking, evaluation metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and testing procedures in Section 6 and the appendices are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the same membership-inference evaluation, expert-weight and insertion-layer analyses, iterative-reasoning example, and Appendix D ablations of base model, token count, token mapping, padding, and schema ranges.

E5.justification: Section 6.1 reports mean accuracy over five independent runs in both versions. The figures' uncertainty displays and all other statistical reporting remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All reported numerical results, plotted trends, and qualitative examples match. For example, Table 2 retains Llamdex-MLP accuracies of 75.51, 41.42, 87.94, and 51.69, and Table 8 retains 76.08 on adult.

T1.justification: The differential-privacy definition, problem assumptions, optimization objective, and token-mapping equations are unchanged. Neither version adds or removes formal reasoning or proofs relative to the other.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about model-based customization, schema-only connector training, privacy, accuracy, and inference efficiency.

C2.justification: Results interpretations and mechanism explanations are identical. Section 8 and Appendices F–G retain the same applicability limits, future directions, and discussion of differential-privacy risks.

D1.justification: Implementation details and reproducibility information are unchanged. Although the repository is relabeled from 'anonymous' to 'GitHub', footnote 1 already supplies the identical GitHub URL in v4, so no access information is added.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, related-work discussion, and positioning against data-based and API-based customization methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: Section 1 changes 'an anonymous repository' to 'a GitHub repository', and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. There are no other textual revisions or structural changes.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, axes, legends, and placement are unchanged. The short wording correction causes only local line wrapping, with no revision to the page organization.

improvement.justification: v5 corrects the repository description while retaining the same link and updates the arXiv stamp. These editorial changes leave the scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation unchanged, producing no meaningful overall quality difference.
